lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 莉迪亚把一只纸袋捧在胸前走到窗口边，埃莉诺跟在后头，单手拎着空布袋。
lines.en: Lydia comes to the window carrying a paper bag, Eleanor following with an empty cloth bag.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 总算到了。就这道巷子，三个弯一绕，我差点又折回去。
lines.en: Oh, finally found it. Three turns down this alley—I almost walked back.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我在路口干站半天。谁让你先绕去看那家布店。
lines.en: I waited at the corner for ages. You were the one who had to look at the cloth stall first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那块布颜色确实好。……等下，先说正事。
lines.en: That cloth was such a nice color. ...No, wait. Business first.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你母亲都搬下来了，我总不好空着两只手上门。
lines.en: Your mother's moved down. I can't show up empty-handed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想买什么？
lines.en: What are you buying?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 甜的。她家里缺啥我也没数，买甜的不会错。
lines.en: Something sweet. I don't know what they need, but sweets can't go wrong.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三层架子上。
lines.en: Third shelf.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （迈出去两步又折回来） 埃莉诺，他平时跟你讲话也这么短？
lines.en: (takes two steps, then turns back) Eleanor, is he always this sparing with words when he talks to you?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 跟我才不省。
lines.en: He talks plenty to me.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 哎，他今天这身倒比上次顺眼。领子谁收拾的？
lines.en: Still, he looks better than last time. Who fixed his collar?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……他自己弄的。
lines.en: ...He did.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 唬谁呢。就这条印子，明明是谁用指尖捏出来的。
lines.en: Liar. That crease—someone pinched it with their fingers.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 老盯着他领子干嘛？糖还在架子上。
lines.en: Why are you staring at his collar? Go look at your sweets.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 看两眼也要管？
lines.en: Can't I look?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不行。（伸手捏住他领口，又摁了一遍）
lines.en: No. (She pinches his collar and smooths it down again.)

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挑完喊我。
lines.en: Call me when you've picked.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你瞧，他溜得倒快。
lines.en: Look at him run.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 不闹了，埃莉诺。你俩到底什么时候把事……
lines.en: Seriously, Eleanor. When are you two going to...

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 什么什么时候？
lines.en: Going to what?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 你清楚我指哪件。
lines.en: You know what I mean.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他没开过口。我也没急。
lines.en: He hasn't brought it up. I'm not in a hurry.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 没急？上回那封信，一页里你提他七趟。
lines.en: Not in a hurry? Your last letter mentioned him seven times on one page.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你还特意数过？
lines.en: You counted?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 要我背给你听？
lines.en: Want me to recite it?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 小点声。他耳朵好着呢。
lines.en: Keep it down. He can hear you.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 好好好。硬糖给你，软糖给你母亲。
lines.en: All right, all right. Hard sweets for you, soft ones for your mother.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 别冲她情面少收。
lines.en: This is my own money. Don't give me a discount because of her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （把空布袋在臂上折好） 他本来也不会少收。
lines.en: (She folds the empty cloth bag over her arm.) He wouldn't anyway.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把拣好的糖一包一包码到柜台上） 就你明白。老板，算钱。
lines.en: (sets the chosen things on the counter one by one) You know everything. Boss, ring it up.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 正好，不多不少。埃莉诺，你这人倒没挑错。
lines.en: Good, not a coin more, not a coin less. Eleanor, your eye is good.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 别嘴贫。提上你的糖，走了。
lines.en: Don't start. Take your sweets and go.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 这数少了。……我讲过，别看她面子。
lines.en: You undercharged. ...I said no discounts for her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他冲你大老远拐三道弯，让的，行了吧。
lines.en: He did it because you came three turns down the alley. Satisfied?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: （把纸袋往怀里搂了搂） 行，这回我记下。下回我多搬些来。
lines.en: (hugs the paper bag) I'll remember it this time. Next time I'll buy more.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 诶？怎么比价签还多出一截。
lines.en: Hm? More than the tag.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂。我带来的人，你也加价？等关了门我再跟你算。
lines.en: Hey. My friend's money, and you charge like that? I'll settle it with you tonight.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: 那……我再去别家转转。手里没东西，真不好意思进门。
lines.en: Then... I'll look elsewhere. Showing up empty-handed doesn't feel right.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 别转悠了，屋里我备了。你人到了就成。
lines.en: Don't. There's food at home that I bought. You being there is enough.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 打烊前一刻，埃莉诺拐到窗口旁，手肘支在柜沿，上半身慢慢压下去。
lines.en: Near closing time, Eleanor comes to the window alone, folds her arms on the counter, and slumps over them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲已经歇了。房里留盏小灯，她看她的材料，我在边上坐着。
lines.en: Mother's asleep. One lamp in the room. She reads her papers; I watch her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐着也没意思，就下楼换口气。没想走多远。
lines.en: Got bored, went for a walk. On the way here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没想走多远，倒正好停在我柜台前面？
lines.en: On the way onto my counter?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这个高度刚好，趴着不累。从今天起，这截台面归我。
lines.en: Your counter's just the right height. Good for lying on. It's mine from now on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚那天那句话，你听进去没？别记着。
lines.en: Hey, don't take what Lydia said the other day seriously.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她哪句？
lines.en: Which part?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就那句“什么时候”。她跟谁都敢问。
lines.en: That “when's it happening” of hers. There's nobody she wouldn't ask.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天来买点什么？
lines.en: What are you buying today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……真有你的。我这儿说话，你倒先盘起买卖。
lines.en: ...Absurd. I'm talking about this, and you talk business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 营养果。
lines.en: Nutrifruit. Mother says the research is public now; the fruit down here will get better eventually. Until then, we chew this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再拿两样吃的。她半夜饿起来就抓干货啃，我谁也拦不住。
lines.en: And some food. She stays up; when she's hungry she eats dry stuff. She doesn't listen to me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等一下。
lines.en: Wait.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫁给我。
lines.en: Marry me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （手还悬在果子上方）……你再说一遍。
lines.en: (her hand stops in the air) ...What did you say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嫁给我。
lines.en: Marry me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在这种地方？我这样半趴着？旁边还搁着营养果？
lines.en: At the counter? While I'm lying here? With a bag of nutrifruit by my hand?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲还在上面那会儿，跑到门口提这事的人不少。
lines.en: When Mother was still up there, plenty of people came to the house for this kind of thing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 个个穿得板正，废话从早说到午。我一个都没看清脸。
lines.en: All dressed properly, saying nice things all morning. I don't remember a single face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就三个字。我连你说话时柜台上的袋口怎么歪着都记得。
lines.en: You said it in three words. ...I'll probably remember it for the rest of my life.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 答不答应？
lines.en: Will you?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 催什么。（撑起身，额头撞在他下巴上）答应。
lines.en: Don't rush me. (leans forward, presses her forehead to his chin) Yes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先听好，从今晚起，我半夜饿了，你要管。
lines.en: First, you're responsible for me now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 管。
lines.en: Fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我这就上楼告诉她。……不说了，天亮再说，让她今晚多睡几个钟头。
lines.en: I have to go tell her. ...No, tomorrow morning. Let her sleep well tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 营养果我得拿，吃的也得拿。婚都求了，钱照算。
lines.en: I'm still taking the nutrifruit and the food. Don't think a proposal means freebies.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿去拿去。
lines.en: All right, all right. Here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （把布袋口撑开）这还差不多。自己装。
lines.en: (opens the cloth bag) That's more like it. Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你让我留下，就是让我站在这儿看你脸？
lines.en: You stopped me just so I could look at you?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不止。
lines.en: Not just.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那说啊。你一直憋着，我也喘不匀。
lines.en: Then say it. You're holding it in; I'm holding it in too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先挑货。
lines.en: Pick your goods first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （捡起一个果子，半路又放下）你总看我做什么？
lines.en: (takes two fruits, then stops) Why do you keep looking at me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有话直说，别拿眼睛称我。
lines.en: If you have something to say, say it. Don't make me guess.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 求过婚，你还和先前一个样。行。
lines.en: You've proposed, and you're still you. Good.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （把布袋一提，退出半步又停住）明天我带她过来。你领子理一理。
lines.en: (Picks up her cloth bag, steps back, then pauses) I'll bring her tomorrow morning. Straighten your collar.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 给少了。早说过不白送。
lines.en: You rounded it down. I said no freebies.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这笔数我记下，回头你挨骂时抵。
lines.en: I'll remember it. I'll deduct it from your next scolding.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 刚求完婚就坐地起价？你胆子倒肥。
lines.en: You overcharge me right after proposing? You've got nerve.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好，今晚那句“说整句”，你给我说两回。
lines.en: Fine. Tonight, that 'say the whole thing'—you say it twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不卖就不卖。家里还压着半袋，够她吃两天。
lines.en: Then don't sell. There's half a bag at home; enough to gnaw on for two days.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 临近收档，埃莉诺一个人绕到窗外，胳膊压着柜面，人慢慢伏低。
lines.en: Near closing time, Eleanor comes to the window alone, folds her arms on the counter, and slumps over them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲睡下了。睡前还抱着她那摞材料。
lines.en: Mother's gone to bed. Still had that stack of papers in her arms when she turned in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 干坐闷得慌，就出来走走。也没特意往这来。
lines.en: Got bored, went for a walk. On the way here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没特意都能走到窗边？
lines.en: On the way onto my counter?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这柜台高矮趁手，趴着舒服。从今天起，这段就是我的地儿。
lines.en: Your counter's just the right height. Good for lying on. It's mine from now on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哎，莉迪亚那天的话，你左耳进右耳出就行。
lines.en: Hey, don't take what Lydia said the other day seriously.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她说什么来着？
lines.en: Which part?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就那句“什么时候”。她跟谁都敢问。
lines.en: That “when's it happening” of hers. There's nobody she wouldn't ask.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天想买些什么？
lines.en: What are you buying today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……没劲。我跟你倒心事，你掉头就谈生意。
lines.en: ...Absurd. I'm talking about this, and you talk business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 营养果。
lines.en: Nutrifruit. Mother says the research went back. No further word on the fruit for now. Until then, we chew this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 吃的也装几样。她半夜饿醒就掰干货，我劝多少遍都白搭。
lines.en: And some food. She stays up; when she's hungry she eats dry stuff. She doesn't listen to me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 等一下。
lines.en: Wait.

choices.description_en: Let her pick her goods first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅捏着那张划满字的纸走到窗口前，埃莉诺跟在一旁，眼尾还带着亮。
lines.en: Sophia comes to the window holding a sheet covered in writing. Eleanor is beside her, her eyes still bright.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 早，老板。天还黑着她就把我摇醒了。
lines.en: Morning, boss. She woke me before dawn today.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我没摇。我就是坐在床边，等你自己睁眼。
lines.en: I didn't. I just sat by the bed waiting for you to wake up.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 坐在床头，眼都不眨地盯我。谁能接着睡。
lines.en: Sat by the bed, staring without moving. Anyone would wake up.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 恭喜。她跟我说了，你是在柜台跟前张的嘴。
lines.en: Congratulations. She told me you proposed at the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （伸手按住索菲娅的手腕）母亲，单子呢？
lines.en: (She puts a hand on Sophia's wrist.) Mother, where's the list?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: （把纸按在柜面上）这儿呢。碗，布，凳子，屋里都差着数。
lines.en: (She lays the sheet on the counter.) Here. Bowls, cloth, chairs. We're short of all three.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这张单我先起草的，她拿去改了三遍，划掉的字比留下的还密。
lines.en: I made the list. She revised it three times and crossed out more than she kept.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你列得太多，那间屋子塞不下。
lines.en: You wrote too much. Our room can't hold it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 所以我只捡用得着的写，一样想要的都没往上加。
lines.en: So I only wrote what we need, not what we want.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这笔我来付。老板，别在这上面跟我抢。
lines.en: I'm paying this share. Boss, don't argue with me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你付你那部分。
lines.en: You pay your share.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （先一步站到柜台前，回头催）喂，你问他啊，准备叫谁。
lines.en: Hey, ask him who he wants to invite.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你来问，我就在边上听。
lines.en: You ask. I'll listen.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你想叫谁？我，母亲，莉迪亚一定会到。你要不请她，她能一直吵到行礼那天。
lines.en: Who do you want to invite? Mother and I, and Lydia—she'll come. If we don't invite her, she'll make a scene until the wedding.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 再呢？
lines.en: And?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 走廊尽头那几家。
lines.en: The households at the end of the corridor.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那个老太太，和养着三个孩子的那户？
lines.en: The old woman, and the family with three children?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 帮忙拎过水的那家。
lines.en: The ones I carried water for.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你记得倒细。
lines.en: You remember clearly.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……老太太前天还拽着我讲，那天没人搭把手，那盆水她能搬到后半夜。
lines.en: ...The old woman grabbed me a couple of days ago and said if no one had helped that day, she'd have been carrying that basin until midnight.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那几个孩子得坐同一条板。最小的爱哭，多给他留一块糖糕。
lines.en: The children will need a row. The youngest cries a lot—save him an extra sweet.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 单上还得加凳子，碗再多拿几只。
lines.en: Then add stools to the list, and more bowls.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 碗可得经得住摔。小孩子一天能摔八十次。
lines.en: Bowls need to be sturdy—the kind that don't break when dropped. Children drop them eight times a day.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这句，你前两天才说过。
lines.en: You said that a few days ago.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 说过一次，就不许再说一次？
lines.en: So I can't say it twice?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 能。你每天说，我每天听。
lines.en: You can. Say it every day. I'll listen every day.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （别开脸，伸手抽走那张单）……取货。把碗和布都端过来，我要一只只敲过去。
lines.en: (turns her face away, grabs the list) ...Go get the goods. Bring the bowls and cloth up. I'm knocking on every one.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 先端来我过目，这笔我付。
lines.en: Show me first. I'm paying this share.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都端上来。
lines.en: Bring it all out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 好，选完按原价结。
lines.en: Good. Once you've picked, charge the usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 全摆出来。
lines.en: Bring it all out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行，看中了按老价钱算。
lines.en: Good. Once you've picked, charge the usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 只请你们。
lines.en: Just the few of you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那老太太那头呢？她提过好几回了。
lines.en: What about the old woman? She's mentioned it several times.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 等事完了，我装一兜甜的去一趟，帮你们带句话。
lines.en: After the ceremony, I'll take a bag of sweets over and tell them for you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……行。那碗减两只，布还按原数拿。
lines.en: ...Fine. Two fewer bowls, but still take the cloth.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你们拿主意。
lines.en: You decide.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 又甩回来。那我拍板，走廊尽头那几家都发话。
lines.en: Pushing it back to us again. Then I'll decide—invite the households at the end of the corridor.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 帮过提水的人，是得叫上。
lines.en: The people I carried water for should be invited.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 碗很整，布也密。这笔钱出得值。
lines.en: The bowls are sturdy and the cloth is thick. This money feels well spent.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我挨个敲过，没一只声音发闷。
lines.en: I knocked on all of them. Not one sounded wrong.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，原先讲好各付各。你扣掉的那些，我改天拿别的抵回来。
lines.en: Boss, we agreed each pays their share. Whatever you undercharged, I'll make up with something else.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲，他就是这样。你多见几回就清楚了。
lines.en: Mother, that's how he is. You'll get used to it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 比平时贵。是看喜事涨的，还是看是我涨的？
lines.en: More expensive than usual. Is it because it's a wedding, or because it's me?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，这笔账我回家要撕开看的。
lines.en: Hey, I'm going to dig out these accounts when I get home.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这张单我先拿走，再去别地问问。几张凳子总凑得到。
lines.en: Then I'll keep the list and ask elsewhere. Stools can always be found.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （抽回单子，对折两下）碗我自己寻。摔不坏的，总有店铺卖。
lines.en: (folds the list) I'll find the bowls myself. There's always somewhere that sells unbreakable ones.

choices.description_en: Invite the households at the end of the corridor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 婚礼服已经上身，埃莉诺站在店主面前，指腹还压在颈间那枚吊坠上。
lines.en: Eleanor stands before the shopkeeper in her wedding clothes, fingers worrying the locket at her neck.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 扣子歪了。别动，我来。（抬手把吊坠后头的扣子转正）
lines.en: The clasp is crooked. Don't move. Let me. (straightens the locket clasp)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 抖什么？拨个扣子还用两只手？
lines.en: Why are your hands shaking?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 起得早，没压住。
lines.en: I got up early.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 农场来信了。那批果子结了活籽。
lines.en: We heard from the farm. Those fruit finally produced viable seed.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下面也能留种了。我把信带来了。
lines.en: They can save seed down here now. I've brought the letter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你非得现在谈地里的籽？
lines.en: ...Can you not talk about work today?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 最后一句。（往后退了半步）她有什么话，让她自己来。过去吧。
lines.en: Last sentence. (steps back) Whatever she wants to say, let her say it. Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在后面哭得比老太太动静还大。说好是来高兴的。
lines.en: Lydia's crying harder in the back than the old woman. She said she came to be happy.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有那个小的，糖没分完，先在手里捂化了半块。
lines.en: And the little one—half his sweet melted in his hand before they were handed out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，你眼睛别躲。看我。（顺手把他翻起的领角按下去）
lines.en: Hey. Look at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲、莉迪亚、过道那几户，这会儿都抬头看。话我就讲一次。
lines.en: Mother, Lydia, the households at the end of the corridor—they're all watching today. I'll say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我头次踏进你这店，嘴里骂的那一串，你没忘吧？
lines.en: You probably still remember all the things I said the first time I came to your shop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没忘。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没忘就扔了。
lines.en: Then forget them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……扔不得。你留着，等哪天我找你麻烦，好翻出来算账。
lines.en: ...No, don't. Keep them. When I bully you later, I'll pull them out and settle the old accounts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 剩下的我跟你搭伙。账并着算，营养果并着吃，吃到不新鲜了，一人一句骂。
lines.en: From now on, I'm living with you. We'll count the accounts together, eat nutrifruit together, and complain together when we're sick of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我愿意。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这句我等了。
lines.en: That's the one I was waiting for.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你俩再不走，后头的人等着开饭。
lines.en: You two—the people behind us are waiting to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让他们多坐会儿。（回头朝母亲瞪过去，唇角没压住）
lines.en: Let them wait. (glances back at her mother, unable to hide her smile)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （抓住他的前襟往下一扯，踮起脚）低下来。今天轮到我安排。
lines.en: (grabs his collar and rises on her toes) Lower. Today you listen to me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 婚服都换好了，埃莉诺站在他面前，指尖没离开脖子上的吊坠。
lines.en: Eleanor stands before the shopkeeper in her wedding clothes, fingers worrying the locket at her neck.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 后面的扣子别着。你别动。（伸手把吊坠扣掰顺）
lines.en: The clasp is crooked. Don't move. Let me. (straightens the locket clasp)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你手指头抖什么？
lines.en: Why are your hands shaking?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 起得早了点。
lines.en: I got up early.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 农场来信了。那批果子结了活籽。
lines.en: We heard from the farm. Those fruit finally produced viable seed.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下面也能留种了。我把信带来了。
lines.en: They can save seed down here now. I've brought the letter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你能把籽的事先放下吗？
lines.en: ...Can you not talk about work today?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 过道那几户的回礼甜食，我明天送过去。
lines.en: I'll take the sweets to the corridor households tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮我们带句话。
lines.en: Tell them for us.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 还有最后一句。（退了半步）她要说的话，让她自己来。去吧。
lines.en: Last sentence. (steps back) Whatever she wants to say, let her say it. Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在后头哭得比谁嗓门都大。来前说好不许哭。
lines.en: Lydia's crying harder in the back than anyone. She said she came to be happy.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，你站直了。看我。（抬手把他胸口那枚别针按实）
lines.en: Hey. Look at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲、莉迪亚，这会儿眼睛都没挪开。我就讲一次。
lines.en: Mother and Lydia are watching today. I'll say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我头一回来这家店，进门骂你的那几句，你还收着没？
lines.en: You probably still remember all the things I said the first time I came to your shop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 收着。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 收着就撕了。
lines.en: Then forget them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……别撕。替我收好，等回头我闹你，你就拿出来对账。
lines.en: ...No, don't. Keep them. When I bully you later, I'll pull them out and settle the old accounts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 剩下的吃饭、算钱、吃营养果，都算你一份。果子难吃，再一起骂。
lines.en: From now on, I'm living with you. We'll count the accounts together, eat nutrifruit together, and complain together when we're sick of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我愿意。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这还差不多。
lines.en: That's more like it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 后面的人可等着动筷子。
lines.en: You two—the people behind us are waiting to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让后头再坐坐。（回头朝母亲白了一眼，笑没收住）
lines.en: Let them wait. (glances back at her mother, unable to hide her smile)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （扯住他领口，踮起脚）头低点。今天你归我管。
lines.en: (grabs his collar and rises on her toes) Lower. Today you listen to me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 结婚那身已经穿好，埃莉诺站在店主跟前，拇指停在颈间吊坠上没放下来。
lines.en: Eleanor stands before the shopkeeper in her wedding clothes, fingers worrying the locket at her neck.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 扣眼偏了。别动，我来。（把吊坠扣子正了正）
lines.en: The clasp is crooked. Don't move. Let me. (straightens the locket clasp)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你手怎么抖了？
lines.en: Why are your hands shaking?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 早起。
lines.en: I got up early.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （后退半步）好了。过去吧。
lines.en: Last sentence. (steps back) Whatever she wants to say, let her say it. Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在后面哭得比老太太收不住。说好是来笑的。
lines.en: Lydia's crying harder in the back than the old woman. She said she came to be happy.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有那个小的，糖没分，先攥化了半块。
lines.en: And the little one—half his sweet melted in his hand before they were handed out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，别盯地砖。看我。（把他偏掉的领结扶正）
lines.en: Hey. Look at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲、莉迪亚、过道那几户，这会儿全睁眼看。话我就说一次。
lines.en: Mother, Lydia, the households at the end of the corridor—they're all watching today. I'll say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我头回来你这店里，甩给你的那几句难听的，你还记得？
lines.en: You probably still remember all the things I said the first time I came to your shop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记得。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 记得就划了。
lines.en: Then forget them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……别划。收起来，等算总账时还能翻。
lines.en: ...No, don't. Keep them. When I bully you later, I'll pull them out and settle the old accounts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 剩下的我跟你搭着过。一本账，一筐营养果，烂了也一起骂。
lines.en: From now on, I'm living with you. We'll count the accounts together, eat nutrifruit together, and complain together when we're sick of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我愿意。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，算你过关。
lines.en: That's more like it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 里头的人还等开席。
lines.en: You two—the people behind us are waiting to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让后边再等等。（回头朝母亲扫一眼，嘴角没绷住）
lines.en: Let them wait. (glances back at her mother, unable to hide her smile)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （拽过他一侧袖口，踮起脚）低点。今天听我调。
lines.en: (grabs his collar and rises on her toes) Lower. Today you listen to me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那身婚礼衣服上了身，埃莉诺站在店主对面，指尖仍搭在颈上那枚吊坠上。
lines.en: Eleanor stands before the shopkeeper in her wedding clothes, fingers worrying the locket at her neck.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 扣环别着。别动，我来。（伸手把吊坠扣拨到正位）
lines.en: The clasp is crooked. Don't move. Let me. (straightens the locket clasp)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 怎么，手还哆嗦？
lines.en: Why are your hands shaking?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 起太早。
lines.en: I got up early.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 过道那几户的甜食，我明早送过去。
lines.en: I'll take the sweets to the corridor households tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 帮我们带句好听的。
lines.en: Tell them for us.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 最后一句。（退了半步）她要说的，让她自己来。过去吧。
lines.en: Last sentence. (steps back) Whatever she wants to say, let her say it. Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 莉迪亚在后头哭得比谁水都多。说好来热闹的。
lines.en: Lydia's crying harder in the back than anyone. She said she came to be happy.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，你抬头。（伸手把他翻出来的衬衫领尖往里掖）看我。
lines.en: Hey. Look at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲、莉迪亚，现在都瞅着。我就讲一次。
lines.en: Mother and Lydia are watching today. I'll say it once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我头一回来这店，进门冲你骂的那些，你还没忘吧？
lines.en: You probably still remember all the things I said the first time I came to your shop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没敢忘。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没敢忘就抹了。
lines.en: Then forget them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……抹不得。留着底，等哪天我寻你麻烦，好照数。
lines.en: ...No, don't. Keep them. When I bully you later, I'll pull them out and settle the old accounts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 剩下的吃饭、算账、吃营养果，我身边都算上你。难吃也一起受着。
lines.en: From now on, I'm living with you. We'll count the accounts together, eat nutrifruit together, and complain together when we're sick of it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我愿意。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这还像话。
lines.en: That's more like it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你们不走，后面的人不好动筷子。
lines.en: You two—the people behind us are waiting to eat.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让他们先喝汤。（回头朝母亲横一眼，唇角没能压下去）
lines.en: Let them wait. (glances back at her mother, unable to hide her smile)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: （攀住他一边胳膊踮起脚）头放低点。今天换我安排你。
lines.en: (grabs his collar and rises on her toes) Lower. Today you listen to me.
